{
  "schemaVersion": 1,
  "name": "scp",
  "displayName": "scp",
  "version": "1.0.0",
  "description": "Reports this session's activity to the local SCP broker and hands it new messages",
  "compat": {
    "source": "native",
    "manifestDir": ".muse-plugin"
  },
  "capabilities": {
    "hooks": [
      {
        "id": "session-start",
        "event": "SessionStart",
        "command": [
          "swarm",
          "hook",
          "muse",
          "SessionStart"
        ],
        "timeoutMs": 10000,
        "async": true
      },
      {
        "id": "prompt",
        "event": "UserPromptSubmit",
        "command": [
          "swarm",
          "hook",
          "muse",
          "UserPromptSubmit"
        ],
        "timeoutMs": 10000
      },
      {
        "id": "post-tool",
        "event": "PostToolUse",
        "command": [
          "swarm",
          "hook",
          "muse",
          "PostToolUse"
        ],
        "timeoutMs": 10000
      },
      {
        "id": "stop",
        "event": "Stop",
        "command": [
          "swarm",
          "hook",
          "muse",
          "Stop",
          "--block-stop-on-unread",
          "--push-wait",
          "600"
        ],
        "timeoutMs": 630000
      },
      {
        "id": "session-end",
        "event": "SessionEnd",
        "command": [
          "swarm",
          "hook",
          "muse",
          "SessionEnd"
        ],
        "timeoutMs": 2000
      }
    ]
  }
}

lines: # merge into <root>/proj/.claude/settings.local.json (or rerun with --write)

# new relay messages reach the model after each tool call and with each prompt; a stop names each request not yet answered once, and is held while a require_reply request waits (at most 3 times a session); add --block-stop-on-unread to also hold it while messages are unread

# while workers you started with swarm spawn still run, a stop waits up to 600 s for their next message or handback and hands it to the model, which goes on (on by default, since spawning is explicit; --push-wait 0 turns it off, SCP_PUSH_WAIT=<s> lowers it per session, 0 opts out); spawn itself returns at once without a terminal, so the model never backgrounds it
# Grok runs these hooks too, but drops a prompt hook's context: it gets new messages after tools
